newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end mostly higher after slow start.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end mostly higher after slow start.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly higher on Monday, as values swung back and forth after Wall Street's choppy start, with Fiat riding out the impact of a bonus share issue while Mediaset powered ahead.
The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.58 percent higher at 14,626 and the blue chip Mib30 ended the day 0.45 percent up at 22,195.
Mediaset closed 5.31 percent higher at 8,078 lire, lifted by news of a 122 percent jump in profits at Spanish TV group Telecinco, in which the Italian group has a 25 percent stake.
Fiat, which went ex-dividend on Monday and paid a one-for-ten bonus issue to shareholders closed almost unchanged at 6,288 lire.
Telecom Italia closed 367 lire higher at 11,216 lire on the first day of trading as a merged entity after absorbing Stet.
Turnover was down to 2.084 trillion lire from 2.71 trillion lire on Friday. The FIB30 September stock index futures contract ended the day 1.19 percent higher at 22,595.
